children: Key provided FY2026 outlook at the Barclays Global Financial Services Conference, forecasting ~8% revenue growth and net interest income up 9–11%.
Presented FY2026 operating guidance: revenue up ~8% (FY25 baseline $7,513M), previously 7–8%.
Net interest income projected up 9–11% (FY25 baseline $4,671M); 4Q exit NIM 3.00–3.05%.
Average loans expected up 4–5%; average commercial loans up 8–10% (FY25 baselines $105.7B/$74.5B).
Noninterest income guidance up 4–5%; adjusted noninterest income up 6–7% (FY25 baselines noted).
Adjusted noninterest expense up ~4%; NCOs to average loans 40–45 bps; ROTCE 9.5–10%.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
